description: Root form detection – empty document, single primitive, literal empty array

tests.name: parses empty document as empty object
parses literal [] at root as empty array
throws on trailing content after a root array
tests.note: The root form spans the whole document; trailing lines must not be silently discarded

tests.name: throws on trailing content after a keyed tabular root
throws on trailing content after a root empty array
parses a root primitive after a leading blank line
throws on a trailing bare token after a root array in non-strict mode
tests.note: The non-strict leniency for trailing content excludes scalar lines (§5.2)

tests.name: throws on a bare token line under a trailing header after a root array in non-strict mode
parses a root line shaped like a header without a colon as a string
throws on an indented root primitive in non-strict mode
tests.note: The non-strict skip for over-indented lines excludes scalar lines (§5.2)

tests.name: throws on an indented root array header
tests.note: Root form discovery reads the first non-blank depth-0 line; an indented first line is over-indented (§8)

tests.name: parses a root primitive whose bracket segment and colon follow an unclosed quote
throws on a scalar line after a skipped over-indented first line in non-strict mode
